title: Siflu
summary: Subdue Siflu and speak with him after the Muramite control breaks.
overview: Subdue Siflu and speak with him after the Muramite control breaks.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Lower Siflu to 15% health rather than expecting a death completion.
Once he becomes immune and stops fighting, the eligible ranger should follow the adventurers dialogue.
Complete the encounter and dialogue before his fifteen-minute appearance ends.
